name: Zero-config tables
summary: Pass only the data: every named array becomes a table with guessed types, labels, filters, sort and paging.

name: Data from an object or a JSON script tag
summary: data takes an object of named arrays, one array, or the selector of a <script type="application/json"> tag.

name: One tab per table
summary: Without pages, each table gets its own tab with its row count.

name: Tab order
summary: tableOrder lists tables first; the rest follow in data order.

name: Table labels
summary: Set the tab and title text of a table.

name: Hide a table
summary: hidden: true drops a table from the deck.

name: Stable row keys
summary: key names the column that identifies a row, for stable selection and relations.

name: Real pagination
summary: First/prev/numbered pages/next/last with a "1–50 of N" range; never a show-more button.

name: Page size and choices
summary: Set the default rows per page globally or per table, and the choices in the picker.

name: Global search
summary: A search box filters rows across searchable columns; limit it to some columns or turn it off.

name: Leave a column out of search
summary: search: false on a column keeps it out of the global search.

name: CSV / JSON export
summary: The export menu downloads the current page or all matching rows as CSV, or all matching rows as JSON; export: false hides it on a placed table.

name: Row density
summary: compact (28px rows, default) or comfortable (36px), globally or per table.

name: Row classes
summary: rowClass(row) adds a CSS class to a row, e.g. to highlight critical rows.

name: Row click handler
summary: onRowClick(row) runs your code when a row is clicked.

name: Empty and no-results states
summary: An empty table and a filter with no matches each show a message with a clear-filters action.

name: Config errors with suggestions
summary: Unknown keys and bad values are listed with a "did you mean" hint; everything valid still renders, and mount() returns the issues.

name: Column type guessing
summary: Types are guessed from the data: number, date, datetime, URL, IP, email, boolean, enum, JSON, long text, text.

name: Tune the guesser
summary: Change the enum limits, long-text length, sample size and the known value orders.
config: guess.enumMaxDistinct, guess.enumMaxRatio, guess.enumMaxLen, guess.longTextLen, guess.sampleSize, guess.knownOrders

name: Custom type detectors
summary: A detector claims a column when its test passes on the sample values; it runs before the built-in checks.

name: Register a column type
summary: types.<name> adds a type (or replaces a built-in one) with its renderer, filter, sort, alignment, format and width.

name: Set a column's type
summary: type picks a built-in type, an alias (badge, object, string) or a registered type; a string shorthand works too.

name: Column labels
summary: Header text; the default is the key humanized, with known acronyms in capitals.

name: Acronyms in labels
summary: acronyms replaces the list of words shown in capitals in generated labels (ID, IP, URL, …).

name: Column order
summary: columnOrder puts some columns first; the rest follow in data order.

name: Include / exclude columns
summary: include keeps only some columns; exclude drops some.

name: Hidden columns
summary: Hide a column; users can show it again from the Columns menu.

name: Columns menu
summary: Show or hide columns from the toolbar (shortcut C), with an In-detail toggle per column.

name: Width and min width
summary: Set a column's width and the smallest width when resizing.

name: Resize columns
summary: Drag a header edge to resize a column.
checkReason: Resize lives in src/sdt/columns/drag.ts (loaded on header hover or the first press on a handle); scripts/verify-cdn.mjs checks it works on first use.

name: Reorder columns by drag
summary: Drag a header to move a column.
checkReason: The ported table has enableColumnReorder; confirm it is on in jsondeck tables.

name: Pinned columns
summary: Pin a column to the left or right edge so it stays visible while scrolling.

name: Alignment
summary: left, center or right alignment for a column's cells.

name: Wrap long text
summary: wrap: true wraps text instead of truncating it.

name: Cell tooltips
summary: tooltip: true shows the full cell text; a function returns your own text.

name: Column class
summary: className adds a CSS class to the column's cells.

name: Badges and colours
summary: Enum columns render as badges; colors maps values to tone names (red, green, …) or any CSS colour.

name: Value order
summary: order sets how enum values sort and list in the filter; severity and p0–p4 orders are known.

name: Link templates
summary: link fills a URL template like https://x/{id} from the row, or a function returns the URL.

name: Computed columns
summary: A column not in the data plus value(row) creates a new column; computed does the same as a separate map.

name: Named formats
summary: number:2, currency:EUR, percent, bytes, relative, date, datetime, json, upper, lower.

name: Custom formats
summary: formats adds or replaces named formats; a column format can also be a function.

name: Custom cell renderer
summary: render returns text, a DOM node (you own its safety) or a React element (ESM).

name: Replace a type's renderer
summary: renderers.<type> swaps the renderer for every column of a type.

name: Filter pills
summary: Add filters from the Filter button (shortcut F); each shows as a pill you can edit or remove.

name: Filter controls per type
summary: text, number, boolean, select, multi-select, date and date-range controls, picked from the column type.

name: Operators
summary: Text: contains, is, starts/ends with, empty; number: =, ≠, >, ≥, <, ≤, between, empty; select: is / is any of / is none of.

name: Fixed filter options
summary: Give a select filter its own choices as strings or { value, label }.

name: Turn filters off
summary: filter: false on a column, or filters: false on a table, removes them.

name: Date presets
summary: Date filters offer today, yesterday, month/quarter/year to date.

name: Default filters
summary: Filters applied when the table opens.

name: Quick filters
summary: A one-row strip of chips, a min/max range with a slider, a toggle or a search box, kept in sync with the pills.

name: Page filter bar
summary: A page-level filter applies to every component that has that field.

name: Facet sidebar
summary: Count per value for chosen columns; click a value to filter.
checkReason: Facets exist as a table option and as a component; no examples.html box shows them yet.

name: Click a chart to filter
summary: Clicking a bar or slice filters the tables of the same dataset on the page (or the listed targets).

name: Sort from the header
summary: Each header's menu sorts ascending, descending or clears the sort.

name: Multi-column sort
summary: The Sort menu (shortcut S) stacks several sort rules.

name: Default sort
summary: "col" sorts ascending, "-col" descending, or { column, direction }.

name: Custom comparator
summary: sort: (a, b) => number compares raw values; sort: false makes a column unsortable.

name: Group rows
summary: Group rows by one or more columns into collapsible group rows; users can change it from the Group by button.

name: Group subtotals
summary: Each group row shows count, sum, avg, min or max per column.

name: Saved views
summary: Save the current filters, sort and columns as a named view from the views menu (shortcut V); stored in this browser.

name: Favorite, pin and default views
summary: Views can be favorited, pinned, set as default, updated or deleted.

name: Pluggable view storage
summary: views.storage plugs in your own store (list/get/save/delete/setDefault/setFavorite); default is localStorage.

name: Turn views off
summary: views: false globally or per table.

name: Pages
summary: pages adds several pages, each with sections; the current page lives in the URL hash.

name: Tabs or sidebar navigation
summary: nav picks page tabs or a sidebar.

name: Sections
summary: Sections have a title, a description, and can be collapsible, nested or shown as tabs.

name: Grid layout
summary: A section's columns is a count or ratios like [2, 1]; it stacks on narrow screens.

name: Item span and height
summary: span sets how many grid columns an item takes; height sets its height.

name: Per-placement table settings
summary: A table placed on a page can override any table setting just for that spot.

name: Layout editing
summary: Edit layout: drag items, change width and height, add or remove components, reset, then Copy config.

name: Preview / Code boxes
summary: code: true wraps an item in a Preview / Code box showing its config; JsonDeck.example() does it for a whole deck.

name: Bar charts
summary: Vertical or horizontal bars of a count or measure per value.

name: Stacked and grouped bars
summary: Split each bar by a second column, stacked or side by side.

name: Line and area charts
summary: Values over time buckets (day, week, month, year), one line per series value.

name: Pie and donut charts
summary: Share per value, with a legend of counts and percents; the donut shows the total.

name: Sparklines
summary: A small line without axes, also used inside stat tiles.

name: Measures
summary: count, sum, avg, min, max or distinct count of a column.

name: Chart filters
summary: where keeps only matching rows, with the same operators as table filters.

name: Top N and Other
summary: top keeps the first N values and folds the rest into Other; topSeries does the same for series.

name: Chart order
summary: Sort by value, by label, or by an explicit list (severity order is used automatically).

name: Chart colours
summary: A validated colour-blind-safe palette in light and dark; severity values get status colours; colors overrides per value.

name: Tooltips and legends
summary: Hover shows a tooltip; charts with several series show a legend.

name: Charts follow table filters
summary: Charts on a page react to the page filter bar.

name: Stat tiles
summary: One headline number from a measure, with an optional where.

name: Stat delta
summary: compare shows the change against a second where, coloured by whether up is good.

name: Stat trend
summary: trend adds a sparkline of the measure per time bucket.

name: Key-value card
summary: One row (picked by key) or a set of aggregates shown as label/value pairs, using the column formats.

name: Markdown blocks
summary: Headings, lists, links, code, quotes and tables; raw HTML is shown as text and unsafe links are dropped.

name: Relations between tables
summary: { from: 'findings.host', to: 'hosts.ip' } turns cell values into links to the related row; arrays work (many-to-many).

name: Row drawer
summary: Clicking a row opens a drawer with all its fields and its related rows in both directions.

name: Expandable rows
summary: A chevron (or Enter) expands a row into a detail panel; without fields it shows the hidden columns.

name: Detail panel fields
summary: Pick the fields and grid columns (1–4) of the detail panel, or render it yourself.

name: Nested drill-down
summary: detail.related shows related rows as nested tables that expand again (depth-limited).

name: Expand into a relation
summary: expand: { relation } expands a row straight into the rows of one relation.
checkReason: Type exists in config.ts; no example box uses it.

name: Expand into the drawer
summary: expand: "drawer" opens the drawer instead of an inline panel; false turns expansion off.

name: Master–detail
summary: Selecting rows in one table filters another to the related rows, with a chip to clear.

name: Row selection
summary: selectable adds a checkbox column; shift-click selects a range.

name: Copy rows
summary: Copy the selected rows as JSON, CSV, TSV (pastes into Sheets/Excel), a Markdown table or key: value text.

name: Right-click menu
summary: Right-click a row or cell for more actions, including copy and your own row actions; the menu works with the keyboard.

name: Custom row actions
summary: rowActions adds your own items to the right-click menu; they get the row and the selected rows.

name: Copy feedback
summary: A small toast confirms a copy (or says it failed).

name: Light and dark
summary: Every deck follows the page theme (html data-theme or class="dark", else the OS); theme can pin one deck.

name: JsonDeck.setTheme
summary: setTheme("light" | "dark" | "auto") switches every deck on the page and remembers the choice.

name: Theme toggle button
summary: themeToggle shows a light/dark switch in the deck's toolbar.

name: CSS colour tokens
summary: Colours are CSS variables on .jd-root (--jds-* for the UI, --jdv-* for charts), so a stylesheet can re-theme them.
checkReason: Variable names may change while the theming work is in progress.

name: Every UI string
summary: labels replaces any UI text; templates use {from} {to} {total} {n} {shown} {table}.

name: Toolbar text labels
summary: toolbarLabels shows text next to the toolbar icons (default: icons with tooltips).

name: defineConfig
summary: defineConfig(data, config) checks table and column names against your data and types row callbacks.

name: Exported types
summary: Every config type is exported (JsonDeckConfig, TableConfig, ColumnConfig, PageConfig, …) plus helper types.

name: JsonDeck.describe
summary: describe(data, config) returns the fully resolved config as JSON in the same shape: copy it, edit what is wrong, pass it back.

name: One script tag
summary: dist/jsondeck.js: a small loader (global JsonDeck) that fetches the core and loads every other part (charts, menus, calendar, drawer, editor, code view) on demand; it links dist/jsondeck.css itself.
checkReason: Not released yet; served from the GitHub tag through jsDelivr once v0.1.0 is tagged.

name: On-demand loading
summary: The split build fetches only what a page uses: a plain table page downloads about 115 kB of JavaScript (React included); charts, popups, the calendar, the drawer, the editor and the code view load the first time they are needed.
checkReason: Not released yet; ships with the next tag.

name: ES module build
summary: dist/jsondeck.mjs with react and react-dom as peer dependencies, plus .d.ts types.
checkReason: Not released yet; the ES module is served from the GitHub tag through jsDelivr (not npm).

name: Works from file://
summary: dist/jsondeck.full.js is one file with everything (CSS included): no fetch and no network calls, so a page with embedded data works opened from disk. The split jsondeck.js shows a message pointing at it there.

name: Host page isolation
summary: Prefixed classes and a reset scoped to the deck: the host page's CSS and jsondeck's never clash.

name: JsonDeck.mount
summary: mount(el, config) renders a deck and returns { unmount, issues }.

name: JsonDeck.example
summary: example(el, { title, description, config }) renders a Preview / Code box with a generated HTML snippet.

name: htmlSnippet / toSource
summary: Turn a config into source code or a full HTML page (CDN tags, trimmed data, mount call).

name: Keyboard shortcuts
summary: / search, F filter, S sort, V views, C columns, ←/→ pages, Esc clear, ? shortcuts help.

name: Shortcuts help
summary: ? opens a dialog listing the shortcuts.

name: Row keyboard
summary: Enter on a row expands it.

name: Menu keyboard
summary: Menus use arrows, Enter, Esc, ←/→ for submenus and typeahead.

name: Accessible charts
summary: Charts have role=img with a label, a hidden data table for screen readers, and focusable clickable bars.

name: Announced toasts
summary: Toasts are announced politely to screen readers.
